answer: Vest earned coin slowly and claw back everything unvested on detection. Rewards release linearly over a long horizon, so value matures from a kernel over many epochs rather than paying out at once. A farm must survive the whole vesting window honestly before extracting — but across that span each audit pulse samples its work, and one caught fake forfeits all unvested balance. With detection probability climbing toward near-certainty over a long horizon, expected take from cheating runs negative: the echo of audit exposure erases unvested gains faster than a sybil earns them.
